notes.title: Update: Operation 5.56 NATO v0.1.19
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
We are excited to present "Operation 5.56 NATO," a major update that introduces new equipment, features, and improvements to enhance your gaming experience! This patch has been carefully crafted to bring fresh content, increased dynamism, and gameplay optimization for more immersive sessions. Here’s what’s in store for you:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783309/6e58a7623452e8442f9fab5f3e6905aed32bc612.png

New Weapons
Expand your arsenal with formidable weapons designed for every scenario:

 CZ Scorpion (Chambered in 9x19mm): A compact SMG, perfect for rapid-fire power.
 AUG A2 (Chambered in 5.56x45mm): A reliable bullpup assault rifle, ideal for precise mid-range shooting.
 SA-80 (Chambered in 5.56x45mm): A British Army bullpup assault rifle, powerful and dependable for accurate mid-range fire.
 MP5 (Chambered in 9x19mm): A submachine gun designed for excellent fire rate and maneuverability.
 M2 Flamethrower: Unleash hell with this incendiary weapon – but watch out, fuel is limited!
 SCP-127: Unique in its kind… this weapon is equipped with "teeth." That's right, a limited 57-tooth magazine.

New Grenades
Bring a new layer of strategy to your battles with these grenades:

 Red & White Smoke: Thick and tactical, perfect for concealing your movements.
 Flash Grenade: Blind your opponents and create a diversion.

New Feature - Skip Radio Cinematic
Because every second counts, you can now skip the radio cinematic and jump straight into the action!

New Achievements
Face new challenges and unlock achievements, including the brand-new "Good morning vietnam!" It's your time to earn them all!

New Containment Rooms
Explore the new containment zones designed for SCP-7328 and SCP-127.
These rooms bring additional content, new weapons, and extra challenges for the boldest players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783309/6e58a7623452e8442f9fab5f3e6905aed32bc612.png

Technical Updates

 Weapon System: Improved for smoother performance, making each shot more satisfying and immersive.
 Settings: Updated to provide more options and optimizations for enhanced comfort and customization.
 Steam Page: Refreshed to showcase the latest features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783309/6e58a7623452e8442f9fab5f3e6905aed32bc612.png

Fixes

 Overall Optimization: Enhanced performance for a smoother gaming experience.
 SCP-939 Attack Animations: Now function correctly, delivering intended damage.
 Increased Damage and Health for SCP-939: Get ready for an even tougher challenge!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783309/6e58a7623452e8442f9fab5f3e6905aed32bc612.png

We hope "Operation 5.56 NATO" adds depth and excitement to your gaming sessions! Thank you for your continuous feedback and support; it’s thanks to you that we keep improving the experience. Have fun, and see you in the game!

- Pixeleur Development Team
